title: Independent verification: separate all five rank-7 frame groups
body:
PR2979 reports independent frame-lowering groups. Earlier audits PR2993 and PR3079 check their isolated deltas and the complete stage. This adds a source-bound reason for local independence: the five groups change disjoint sets of 26/17/17/16/16 register paths. All 32 group subsets in both providers have exactly additive paid-rank profiles and entrance-relative width inventories, for any additive rank tariff.

The checker reconstructs 11,895 frame transitions per provider, including zero-rank transitions, with an independently implemented annihilator-character representation. No producer, solver or predecessor verifier is imported. The receipt binds every transition, records all 64 subset cases and verifies every higher Boolean interaction coefficient is zero. The written proof and register-support lists are in `research/rank7-group-interactions/README.md` and `RESULT.json`.

Validation on CPython 3.12.14, Linux:

- Registered replay: `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-group-interactions` passes.
- Five test methods include all 67 subspaces of F2^4 and 4,489 independent inclusion comparisons.
- Semantic controls reject altered preimages, missing/duplicate edits, triple-only receipt corruption and nonmonotone paths. A legal shared-register example has interaction `2H1-H2` despite equal rank mass.
- An optimized, isolated, Git-free read-only export reproduces the receipt and rejects corrupted source bytes.
- All three inputs match exact PR2979 head `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`; source and provenance pins pass. Only eight new package files are added.

Scope: finite stage-one local frame accounting. Physical allocation and idle bills, native/scalar operators, phases, private zero return, precision/tape, supplier caps and full theorem obligations remain outside this check. This does not contradict PR3014's allocation obstruction or certify PR2979's claimed kappa. The selected conditional kappa remains 0.001672660197076918.

Base: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. Contribution: `0895ada2cef723e05a12d492faa673b087a3655e`. OS assignment seed 75, independent verification. Refreshed PR/discussion overlap excludes the active group-A native, peer-private return and V45 allocation-control audits.

Credit: Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979 and PR2942; Jeremy Kothe's frame lineage and PR2957; Mason Hale/PR2917; Jeremy Diviney/PR2908; Nick Petalas/PR2993 and PR3014; Gonzalo-Mier/PR3079; Ross Richardson/PR2987; and the original credited construction lineage. Existing deltas are corroborated, not claimed as new. Prepared for Charan (@theon199) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; no independent human or proof-kernel review claimed.
